title: Mayfair Upholstered Bed – Luxury Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Mayfair Upholstered Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a decorative line headboard on a solid timber slatted base, handmade to order in Dewsbury for classic and contemporary bedrooms.

Key features

  • Mayfair decorative line headboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Solid timber slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £298.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £357.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes; custom fabric and colour options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What sizes does the Mayfair Upholstered Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I choose a different colour or fabric?

Yes. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, and custom fabric and colour requests are welcome.

Where is the Mayfair Upholstered Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid wood frame.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check the colour and texture at home before ordering.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse all upholstered beds or read how to choose an upholstered bed. Also see the Mayfair Wingback Bed.
